hero.title:
Say what you want.
Matemind splits it up, keeps watch, and gives you the bottom line.
hero.subtitle: The first mate for your AI coding agents. Your agents do the work on your machine. Matemind learns your standards, watches the sessions, and reports back to your phone.

notification.title: Review passed
notification.content:
"3 files changed. Reviewer: pass.
Report ready to share."

showcase.title:
Start in the terminal.
Continue on your phone. Switch back any time.
showcase.subtitle: Your session runs on your machine. Your phone is a window into it. Work in the terminal with the official Claude Code or Codex. Switch to the phone when you leave. Press space twice to switch back.

localCore.title: Runs on your machine
localCore.desc: Agents run on your own computer. Your data stays there.

remoteControl.title: Control from your phone
remoteControl.desc: Use the web app, the PWA, or the Telegram Mini App.

modeSwitch.title: Switch any time
modeSwitch.desc: Move between the terminal and the phone. The session keeps its context.

startAnywhere.title: Start from your phone
startAnywhere.desc: Start Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini or OpenCode sessions from the phone.

seamlessChat.title: Continue the chat
seamlessChat.desc: Pick up the conversation where you left it.

fullTerminal.title: Terminal
fullTerminal.desc: Run commands on the working machine.

powerfulCommands.title: Slash commands
powerfulCommands.desc: Use the agent's slash commands and skills from the phone.

manageWorkspaces.title: Many sessions, one list
manageWorkspaces.desc: Tag, pin and snooze sessions. See which one needs you.

lifestyle.title: What Matemind adds
lifestyle.subtitle: Matemind does not orchestrate agents. It understands you. Your agents are the crew.

explore.title: Understand you
explore.desc: Matemind proposes memories from your own words, each with your quote. You approve them. Group chat sends tasks to sessions with @name.

sip.title: Keep watch
sip.desc: Tags, tasks, pin and snooze keep many sessions in order. Approve requests from your phone. Track quota across Claude accounts.

walk.title: Bottom line
walk.desc: Agents publish reports with share links. A reviewer session checks the work before it reaches you.

telegram.title: Group chat between sessions
telegram.desc: Put sessions in a group. @name sends a task to one session. @all sends it to every online member. A shared note tracks goal, progress, to-dos and risks.

yolo.title: Review loop
yolo.desc: Pick a worker and a reviewer. The reviewer passes the work, sends it back with feedback, or asks you. The loop stops at a round limit.

terminal.title: Reports you can share
terminal.desc: Agents write reports through MCP tools. Share a report with a public link. No login needed to read it.

step1.title: 1. Start on your machine
step1.desc: Run the Matemind hub and start a session. It keeps the session alive for remote access.

step2.title: 2. Open on your phone
step2.desc: Open the web app or the Telegram Mini App. Log in with your access token.

step3.title: 3. Say what you want
step3.desc: Your agents do the work. Matemind keeps watch and gives you the bottom line.

installation.title: Get started
installation.e2ee: 🔒 The relay is end-to-end encrypted with WireGuard + TLS
